interpretation: Warm core API calls include host allocation, current-input upload and result readback; initialization and cold calls are separate.
All rows are published, including GPU losses. No full compiler pipeline is timed.
The 32 core rows use four array sizes but a fixed257-node graph; graph metadata records actual sizes for the five module cases.
CPU wins every tested graph case and every1024-element core workload. GPU wins larger fold/sort/hash batches; scan is still faster on CPU at all measured sizes.
Do not multiply these ratios by earlier optimization ratios or compare absolute latencies across sessions with different desktop/GPU load.
Crossovers are observations at these sampled inputs, not calibrated offload thresholds. The CPU comparator is not optimized upstream LLVM or a parallel vectorized reference.
